statement.text: Let $A$ be a finite set and $ B=\{ n \geq 1 : a\mid n\textrm{ for some }a\in A\}. $ Is it true that, for every $m>n\geq \max(A)$, $ \frac{\lvert B\cap [1,m]\rvert }{m}< 2\frac{\lvert B\cap [1,n]\rvert}{n}? $
